runs.text: Fresh views and three paired seeds
Can crop and color augmentation improve field performance?

Question: how much clean-to-field performance is lost, and can crop/color augmentation reduce it? The main comparison now consists of six independently trained models. The legacy two-fixed-view single-seed result is retained as a reference.

A stronger next study needs independent field labels

Observed conclusion: Strong augmentation improved both field metrics on average, but the paired improvements were not consistent across all three seeds. The follow-up was designed after the legacy test results were inspected, so this is exploratory evidence on an already examined benchmark. Field labels never enter optimization or checkpoint selection. The old CPU single-seed comparison is not a pure ablation of fresh views because RNG and environment also changed.
